observations.classification: Existing retained parent and recorded subcontracts; independent bounded 95e confirmation, no new count.
observations.trace: Current context.open maps native adapter and device request errors to constant anyhow messages and, on wasm presentation, maps native surface creation error to a constant. The native package declares non-exhaustive RequestAdapterError with NotFound backend diagnostic bitsets or EnvNotSet, RequestDeviceError with cfg-specific inner representation and CreateSurfaceError with private Hal/Web/RawHandle kinds. The SDK Error::source implementation is specific: Core/Hal arms delegate to their inner error.source(), Web has None, and the RawHandle source depends on std cfg. Do not assert the immediate private variant is always directly downcastable or every lower cause survives. Hair headless path separately constructs HairGpuError::Adapter/Device with native error values. No adapter/device/surface request ran.
observations.future_direction: After the audit gate, preserve native error values with useful context through the actual boundary and reconcile browser JsValue transport and platform-specific source chains; retain original 059 identities and user-facing policy.

observations.classification: Existing retained parent and recorded map-cause subcontracts; independent bounded 95e confirmation.
observations.trace: The wgpu BufferAsyncError is a native unit struct with generic Display and Error, not a record containing hidden per-buffer diagnostics. Current Buffer.read debug-formats the native mapping error into anyhow text; the wasm mapping path discards the value, while the channel-closed branch and poll outcomes are separate. Current compute ReadbackError has a distinct Mapping native field and Poll native field. No mapping, wait, error or readback was run; actual all callers and source chain policies remain open.
observations.future_direction: After the audit gate, retain available native class and outcome ownership without inventing payloads absent in BufferAsyncError; preserve channel and polling distinctions and reconcile known aliases.

observations.classification: Bounded API contract and existing validation-owner relationship; no new incident.
observations.trace: Native on_uncaptured_error receives a typed Error handler. Error distinguishes OutOfMemory/Validation/Internal and retains a boxed source; formatting need not preserve downcastable ownership. ErrorScopeGuard is !Send/!Sync; explicitly calling pop returns the Option<Error> future and records popped state, whereas dropping an unpopped guard calls pop and drops its future. Separately inspected current ValidationScope.finish polls and explicitly pops, returning distinct Native, Progress, or ProgressWithNative cases; Uncaptured mode creates no guard. This is source semantics and cfg-qualified code, not an observed scope, asynchronous completion or device failure. Existing kernel validation ownership and poll observations remain separately attributed.
observations.future_direction: After the audit gate, trace every guard owner, early return, cancellation and completion policy; retain typed native and progress outcomes where supported without changing borrowed-device/browser observation mode by inference.

bounded_nonfindings: wgpu and wgpu-types are external SDK/API and encoding boundaries; raw diagnostic strings, publicly constructible SDK categories and native buffers do not automatically violate project bespoke value rules.
BufferAsyncError is a unit category; loss of its type/class is not evidence that a detailed hidden source exists.

Roles0 and28 intentionally remain separate audit identities despite identical archive member and hash. Their source windows, earlier reviewer histories and fresh displays do not merge into full-device read credit.
Device/Surface Error::source forwarding behavior depends on backend/std cfg and may skip to a nested source or return None; preserve actual typed wrapper and do not infer an unavailable chain.
A rustc cfg, package presence in a lock or source declaration alone proves neither selected features nor a successful GPU/device operation.
open_questions: What is the supported terminal and browser JsValue transport policy for context construction, and can every native typed cause be retained across those boundaries?
Which application APIs construct or drop validation scopes on early return or cancellation, and which observations must be reported for borrowed, owned or browser devices?
What are the exact feature/target configurations in real builds and the native error-chain behavior for each backend? The locked source alone does not establish them.
What callers of Buffer.read require preserving map versus channel versus poll failures, and how do prior queue aliases reconcile without collapsing distinct first failures?

Which remaining SDK members and first-party owners were not inspected? Roles0 and28 leave device.rs 1–397, 429–684, 751 and (apart from registered tail support) 854–877 outside assigned role credit; other uninspected complements are explicit in receipts.
